sources.section: 🤖 AI Driven Robots and Robotic Dogs
sources.entry: Boston Dynamics Spot - The well-known quadruped robot built for terrain adaptability, heavy-duty tasks, and integration with high-level applications. Spot is often used in security, inspections, and industrial automation.

summary.name: Boston Dynamics Spot
summary.one_liner: Spot is a mobile quadruped robot from Boston Dynamics used for autonomous inspections, site monitoring, and hazardous-situation sensing in industrial settings.
summary.what_it_does: Spot is a quadruped mobile robot built for manual operation and autonomous missions. It can follow repeated inspection routes, capture site data, and provide insights into routine operations, site health, or hazardous situations. Its pre-configured packages cover inspection, research, and hazardous response, and it has 14 kg of payload capacity with an API and documentation for custom equipment. Spot can charge itself, replan around new obstacles, and self-right after a fall. Orbit is the companion software for managing a Spot fleet, facilities, and inspection data, and the Spot Arm adds object manipulation.
notable: Autonomous charging, dynamic replanning around obstacles, and self-righting after falls
14 kg payload capacity with robust API and documentation
Orbit software for fleet and facility management and industrial inspections
Optional Spot Arm for manipulating objects
caveats: Pricing is not stated on the page; enterprise deployment is offered through sales and support
Extra payloads and software options come from Boston Dynamics and partners, so capabilities depend on added equipment
Page reports over 1,500 robots in customer hands, but it does not give per-unit cost or availability details
